book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Dowan Weng Olo Luke Dolanebuotabe.

content: Yesuse imin hanasebe.
Gode singkalin amo blimano sonoma Sande boman tebua unangi Monoba gloutem unomo geniba wel aayo tang kunin ayamo kla oletniba
motemiba tome amite dobdou unibbue daisa dabaiba tanea ken tam unebua amito keim bua
i tam temib otane Sume Yesuse dame blim kesoa
i bobolo hekhek fumbianiba temiba naka asunai youm namao ayalo ulabo dlusanibbua meb ye mablib kesoa
unangi yatemniba tosiananiba dlong dlong golbuaniba daak touniba gabam delab masiba naka asu dabi baabeniba E tom tem olo dofaibbu otane e olo mo biebabe. E hananea unebo,
ibo gloutem olo mo henimibe! E sino Galili ye bianea baabenebio yo funaine!
E baabenea I Abilim Da Tlemin Naka ne hengmin nakai kweiban dimo nemfaiba atdimo nemasaniba silo biki nanaiba kaania amo asu kenia make dime imin hananamabibo genebiobo ge baabesiba
i sino Yesuse weng olo baabenebiobe funaniba
gloutemo deiboniba imin moniba e okok aleyemin nakai 11 isa naka mak isa inamin namino watemibo wengo baabesiobe.
Malia Magdala osa eka Yoana osa Malia afeto Yemse biem osa eka unang maki i bekebe haabi tlib isa i weng olo Yesuse okok dlasanin nakai baabesiba
Yesuse okok dlasanin nakai funaniba Weng olo bainbabo geniba i mo bainobo geim blim deibeib otane
Fita eta monea gloutem unanea delab manea biin wato temea youmob bio kesoa watemnea imin monea bib unanea inamin namino tam tloa wateme olo funmonsebe.
Naka asuei Yesuse Emeas bib deib unemin ye atemsiobe.

Am olo dimo olota i isak temo naka maki asu keniba moniba bib gwabo niniino Emeas bib ye onsibo deib ele Yelusalem bib ye daniba moniba Emeas bib olo unom gaibo afok smiko olokiem blimanota mota bib olo onabiobe.
I dabo bebianiba inamin namino tam tlo olo wengo obianiba tekam bebiba
Yesuse tenea isu ye tlanea bekebe bebe otane Gode
i kin deibo waise bia i atemib otane i mo tekein kenibta Yesus etabo geim blimobe.
E baabenea Ib dabo nimin weng obibe? gesea i bobol temo abilu bebio kesoa maniba dleban bianiba
make niniino Kliobas eta baabaneo Bib mak nakai homoni memalo Yelusalem bib ye mibianiba inamin namino Yelusalem bibo tam tebuo watemebib otane kobole mo tekein keim blim bianebtio? gesea

Yesuse baabenea Nimine? gesea i baabaniba Ni Yesuse weng sang ota obuobo, Yesuse Nasalet bib sake Gode weng omkeimalin naka kesoa e okok sbalo okok kebianea weng sbalo Gode kin dim osa eka nakaia unangai kin dim osa omkeimabea

Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwal isa eka nib komokwal isa doboniba Lom seli komok sume kweiban dimo dofaniba baaniba Ananomo gesiba e Ae anaine gesea i atdimo dabasaniba silo bikiniba anaiba kaanesobe.
Yuda ni sino funanoba Naka ele Islel naka ni wasi nakai kweiban dimo dotlanamabebo ge funanobbu otane i anaiba kaanesobe. Weng mak osa memalo e kaanea tom temo dobbunibbuo amo asumatna blimanobe.

Eka memalo boman tebuo ni isak temo unang maki moniba gloutemo unaniba Yesuse dame mo atemin blim otane i abiseli yatemiba i baabeniba E hananea afen anea unebo ge baabeibta deibe tlobobo gesiba ni wentenoba bobol hekhek funanoba
nimalosak naka maki motemib otane i Yesuse mo atemin blimobe. Isa makob unangi watem tlibbiota watemiobo gesiba
Yesuse baabenea Ib bobol tem funino blimobe. Ibo Gode weng omkeimalin nakai wengo dolaibbuo hebmamsabo mo bainobo gabibbabe.
I dolaniba baaniba Gode Dofakamin Nakae Klaiste enin kino watemneta mitdaneta moneta abilimo unamabebo ge baaniba dolaibbiobo ge baabene ole
eka Moses esa eka Gode weng omkeimalin naka isa i buk temo ele weng sango dolaibbuo mito alukum oye bianea aleye biam bia
moniba Bib olo unomo geniba bebibo meb unaniba Yesuse imin ye unang genamsea
asu dabi wataniba baabaniba Kobo ni bekebenale! Memalo afoko dawab banobio kesoa namo namo belo ngananamabobo ge baabasiba Yesuse tamnea i am tam unanea i dabo bekebe bia
mitdaniba imeno dowonom genamib kesoa Yesuse i dabo heba tounea blete obo helanea Gode gangobo genea oya
i atemniba tekein keniba Yesus etabo geiba e blimanea i imino mo atemin blim kesiobe.
I obianiba Nibo deib tema deibo tebobo e wengo oye bianea Gode buk tem wengo mitmakamo omkeimayem tebea nib bobol temo klayam fun tlobobo ge omomniba
am olo dimo olota imin moniba Yelusalem bib ye temniba Yesuse okok aleyemin nakai 11 isa eka alawal mak isa blibo temnaniba mibianiba
i naka asu dabi baabeibo Motonobo, Sume imin hananea tlea Saimone atemebo gesiba
asu dab isak inamin namino deib tama deibo watem tlibo wengo oye bianiba baabeniba E blete helanea Gode gangobo geneta ni dabo atem tekein ke tlobobo ge baabesiobe.
Yesuse e okok aleyemin nakai atemsiobe.
I weng olo obib dim ota Yesuse isak daak manea baabenea Ib bobol temo ayam bianibte ge baabesea
i dlou unaniba tosiananiba fumbianiba Unimine ye atemobobo gansiba
Yesuse baabenea Ibo fatnanibta dlou une bianibta bobol temo asusu blibe?
Ne skila kweilao nafunibta temine! Netabe. Ne diim osa on osa bitnebiobe. Otane smike diimo blim eka ono blim nabo ge baabenea
e skila kweilao alebenea
i seimbianiba Bain etio? gabianiba bobolo hekhek funsiba Yesuse baabenea Ibo imeno mo bione? gesea
i aningo atosin mako funibbuo omansiba
omonea unansea atememsiba

baabenea Sino ibte nete nabianoba baabenia Sinanggwano ne weng sango Mosese hekmel wengo tem osa Gode weng omkeimalin nakai buk tem osa eka buk Samo tem osa alukum yamo balinamabobo ge baabeibiobo ge baabenea
e Gode wengo omkeima alebeia i Gode wengo buk temo mitmakamo tekein keine genea i bobol tem funin ayamo omyenea
baabenea Gode buk temo baanoa Gode Dofakamin Nakae enin kino watemnea kaanea amo asu kenea make dime imin hana tlea

eka naka maki e niniino mikiktemo Yelusalem bib seli sino omyenibta mitdata bib mak bib mak sel isa Gode Dofakamin Nakae Klaiste niniino omkeimaniba omkaye bianiba baabeniba Ib hengmino deiboniba ib bobol temo deskinaniba Gode omaliba e ib hengmino omtlabeneko ge baabenomabiobo genobiobe.
Eka ibo inamin namin olo watemibo wengo baabeine!

Wentine! Sino Aye baanea Naka ele dobiamabibo genebuo ne memalo utnia abilim ut unamio dababeia tlamabebe. Ibo bib sum olota blibta dabaia daak tenea titil sumo omyeta mitdanibta bib mak bib mako monibta ne wengo omkeiman haanine ge baabesebe.
Gode Yesuse debeb ulanea abilim onsebe.
E okok aleyemin nakai dleb monea Betani ye unanea kweilono tebelubenea Gode baabanea Daabenale ge baabanabea
Gode debeb ulanea abilim unea
i e niniino dobtouleb bianiba imin moniba Yelusalem bib unaniba seimbianiba
Gode am sumo tem tamo mibianiba Gode niniino dobtouleb monsiobe.
